newsitem.title: USA: Iridium satellites launch set for May 2. [CORRECTED 00:07 GMT 01/05]
newsitem.headline: Iridium satellites launch set for May 2. [CORRECTED 00:07 GMT 01/05]

text.p: The first five satellites for the IRIDIUM LLC communications project are scheduled to be launched Friday, more than three months after the explosion of a Delta II rocket delayed the launch, according to a news release from IRIDIUM.
The launch of the McDonnell Douglas Corp Delta II rocket with the satellites would be the first Delta II launch since a Delta II rocket exploded January 17.
The launch is set for 1112 EDT at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California, IRIDIUM said.
(Corrects launch time from 0512 EDT to 1112 EDT.)

IRIDIUM is about 25 percent owned by Motorola Inc. IRIDIUM is an international consortium of 17 companies, including Motorola, Sprint Corp, Lockheed Martin Corp, Raytheon Co and Pacific Electric Wire & Cable Co.
